C0117.title: A Major Insurer's Ad Fraud Prevention Case
C0117.summary: A leading domestic insurance company faced fraudulent traffic generated by black-market actors using emulators and device farms. Shumei Technology successfully identified 16% of risky devices through real-time risk device recognition, effectively reducing exposure to fraudulent traffic and saving tens of millions in annual advertising costs.
